name: cribsheet-pi-shim
description: Root shim so `pi install git:github.com/georgeharker/cribsheet` finds the Pi extension under plugins/pi. Not published — the installable npm package is @geohar/pi-cribsheet (published from plugins/pi). Kept minimal: no dependencies, no "type", no "workspaces", so it stays invisible to the Python project at the repo root and to scripts/bump-version.sh.
